defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced against PO-4424, only 52 EACH received (8 kits damaged in transit and refused at the dock) — clause 4 under-delivery
rationale: Receipt GR-7724 records 52 of 60 EACH received (8 refused as damaged), so payment is limited to the received quantity under clause 4: 52 x $320.00 = $16,640.00 net. Unit price matches the PO exactly (clause 3). Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate on the corrected net is $1,248.00, giving $17,888.00 gross; the supplier's $1,440.00 tax reflects only the over-invoiced quantity, not a rate error, so it is not a separate clause 5 defect. Single defect, no credit memos, so clause 11 escalation is not triggered; AP_MANAGER band per clause 10.
